title: On Tapping twice on the window pane
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：tap　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tap 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the fisherman ① tapped twice on the window pane at once, and every boatman in the harbour said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the fisherman ② taps twice on the window pane in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ tap twice on the window pane at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ tapped twice on the window pane before — a line in the logbook for July 1951 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Tapping twice on the window pane at once, the fisherman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ tap the spring beyond the orchard in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Tap the spring beyond the orchard at once and never mention it again.

By 1964 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the logbook, and a new boatman from the next harbour ⑧ taps the spring beyond the orchard at once every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pier, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ tapped twice on the window pane again when nobody else would.

⑩ To tap twice on the window pane, my mother said in 1969, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the harbour remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the harbour forgets, somebody taps twice on the window pane in the rain again and somebody must tap twice on the window pane at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 轻敲（一般过去式 tapped twice on the window pane：1957 年渔人头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 轻敲（一般现在 taps twice on the window pane：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 轻敲（不定式 to tap twice on the window pane：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 轻敲（过去完成时 had tapped twice on the window pane：1951 年七月的航海日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 轻敲（动名词 tapping twice on the window pane 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 开发（tap the spring beyond the orchard：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去开发开发果园那边那眼泉）
G. v. 开发（tap the spring beyond the orchard：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 轻敲（后段两处：新来的船工照例 taps the spring beyond the orchard，而母亲又一次 tapped twice on the window pane）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 tap 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the fisherman tapped twice on the window pane at once, and nobody in the harbour forgot it.
Even now the fisherman taps twice on the window pane in the rain whenever the harbour asks.
Tapping twice on the window pane at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever tap the spring beyond the orchard in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new boatman from the next harbour taps the spring beyond the orchard at once every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother tapped twice on the window pane again, and the harbour remembered that half.
